metadata.description: Nexika - the next wisdom for Claude Code: plugins that make Claude work smarter and help people learn deeper.

plugins.name: prof
plugins.description: Personal programming professor: lessons, project onboarding for juniors, start-of-session warm-ups and end-of-session learning reports.

plugins.name: barq
plugins.description: Many file and project operations in one call: batched and symbol reads, a seen-before cache, short test/build output, git status with next steps, secret masking and savings stats.

plugins.name: itqan
plugins.description: Quality workflow without the friction: plan, failing tests first, implement, verify, specialist review; a risk-based guard; stack checklists only for the stacks a project uses.

plugins.name: siyaq
plugins.description: Project knowledge loaded only when relevant: entries generated from your docs, multilingual matching (Arabic included) with ranking and a token budget, file triggers, usage stats.

plugins.name: amin
plugins.description: A repository maintainer that never merges for you: issue triage with approval, issues worked into pull requests in isolated worktrees, change notes enforced in CI, step-by-step releases.

plugins.name: manar
plugins.description: Be found by search engines and AI assistants: deterministic audits, fixes written into your code, and measured AI visibility (Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude) compared across releases.

plugins.name: bayan
plugins.description: Claude writes like a clear, friendly person in English and Arabic: explanations for readers with no coding experience, automatic clean-up of machine habits, and a line-by-line style check.

plugins.name: hafiz
plugins.description: Claude remembers your work: decisions, tasks, problems, files and links captured without AI calls, a short start card, a snapshot restored after compaction, handoff notes, Arabic and English search, and a detailed summary on request.

plugins.name: haris
plugins.description: Guards your machine and your accounts from harmful agent actions: a real shell parser, decisions by action and target (allow, ask or deny with a plain reason), protected secrets, persistence spots and haris itself, secret checks on data leaving the machine, prompt-injection warnings, and approvals only from what you type.

plugins.name: mizan
plugins.description: Keeps your session in balance: a band above the prompt with the branch and who started it, open PRs or MRs per person, the branch's CI, RAM and disk warnings, the context level (fresh, mid, full), the running agent, the current task step and the cost; at full context a hafiz handoff and /clear ready for you to send. English and Arabic.

plugins.name: tabib
plugins.description: Finds out why CI failed, with evidence: the failing tests from the log, the kind of failure (code, one Python or OS only, flaky, infrastructure, dependencies), the commits since the last green run, the failing tests run again in a throwaway worktree, and the cause backed by the code. Diagnoses only; never edits, pushes or re-runs CI. English and Arabic.
